title: HF280 (2019-2020 Regular): Firearms; permitted and trained school staff allowed to carry firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2019/0/HF/280/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text. Section 2 also strikes an "or" and a period to add clause (10). Effective the day after final enactment.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 299C.26): (a) The superintendent of the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, in consultation with security and law enforcement experts with appropriate qualifications and experience in responding to active shooter situations, must establish a school and postsecondary institution teacher and employee firearm training program that includes at a minimum training in active shooter situations. (b) The training must be provided at no cost to teachers and other employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d): (10) teachers and employees of public elementary, middle, and secondary schools; charter schools under chapter 124E; and postsecondary institutions under chapter 136F or 137 who have a school permit to carry under section 624.714, subdivision 8b.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, new subd. 8b): (a) A teacher or other employee of a public elementary, middle, or secondary school; charter school under chapter 124E; or postsecondary institution under chapter 136F or 137 may apply to the sheriff of the county where the teacher or employee resides for a school permit to carry. (b) Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a school permit to carry to an applicant if, at the time of submitting an application to the sheriff, the applicant: (3) has successfully completed the training program under section 299C.26 within one year of the date of the application for the school permit to carry; (h) A school permit to carry issued under this subdivision expires one year after the date of issue.
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (d) This subdivision does not apply to teachers and employees authorized to carry firearms under section 609.66, subdivision 1d, paragraph (f).
